bundle.shortDescription: DNA cloning workbench — an independent reimplementation of Serial Cloner
bundle.longDescription: SerialClon.rs is an open-source, maintained reimplementation of the Serial Cloner molecular biology workbench: the same windows, interactions, keystrokes and file formats (.xdna, FASTA, GenBank, ApE, Vector NTI, MacVector) on a Rust + Tauri stack. Not affiliated with SerialBasics.
